Messages.Author: Arnaud Clavel
Messages.Body:
My prince is tapped and my prey annouce a +1 stealth D action against
another methuselh. After the target methuselah has failed or declined to
block, I decide to try to block with the prince with eagle sight. The
question is : Can I play 2nd tradition + eagle sight to block or do i
have to first wake+eagle sight to gain the opportunity to block then
play 2nd trad for intercept ?

tk :
Klav

Messages.Author: jero...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <3A7FC4CD...@renault.com>,
Arnaud Clavel <Arnaud...@renault.com> wrote:


you can't play Eagle Sight while tapped.
You can't untap via 2nd unless you are able to attempt to block.

Solution: play wake/forced awakening, then Eagle's sight, then
intercept.


